answers.greeting: Hi! 😊 I'm the Rocket Strike helper. Ask me about controls, tricks, multiplayer, settings or any problem, or tap the pulse button and I'll run a check.
answers.thanks: You're welcome! Have fun out there, and ask me anytime. 🚀
answers.bye: See you on the pitch! Tap me whenever you need help. 👋
answers.about-helper:
I'm the Rocket Strike helper: the orb with the face. I run right here on your device, so I answer instantly. For harder questions I ask the cloud helper on the game server. My mini helpers search the game's code, the web (SearXNG) or Wikipedia first, so that costs just one cloud call.
- Drag me anywhere.
- Tap me to open the text bar; tap me again to close it.
- The pulse button runs a check of your game.
answers.what-is-game: **Rocket Strike** is rocket-car football in your browser: drive, boost, jump and flip to hit a giant ball into the other team's goal. Play against the bot, or online with friends through invite links. No download, no account, free.
answers.who-made: Rocket Strike was made with AI by a young creator who is learning to code. It's open: anyone can read the source code (Settings → Proof has the link), and the community is on Discord.
answers.free-download: It's **free** and runs in the browser: nothing to download or install, no account, no ads, no passwords. It works on computers, phones and tablets (like iPad) in Safari or Chrome.
answers.safe: Yes, it's safe: **0 viruses**, no downloads, no ads or trackers, and it never asks for passwords or payment. Your name and settings are saved only in your browser. Settings → **Proof** lists every link the game uses, so you can check (even on VirusTotal).
answers.controls-keyboard:
Keyboard controls:
- **W / S** or arrows: drive and reverse
- **A / D**: steer
- **SPACE**: jump (press again in the air to flip)
- **SHIFT** or **L**: boost
- **Q / E**: air roll
- **C**: ball camera on/off
- **ENTER**: chat (online)
answers.controls-touch: Touch controls (phone/tablet): drag on the **left side** of the screen to drive and steer (it's a stick), and use the on-screen **JUMP**, **BOOST**, **CAM** and **CHAT** buttons. Tap JUMP again in the air to flip.
answers.controls-gamepad: Controller: **left stick** steers and pitches in the air, **right trigger** drives, **left trigger** reverses, **A / Cross** jumps (again to flip), **B / X** boosts, **LB / RB** air roll. Plug it in or pair it, then press a button.
answers.flip: To **flip**: jump, then within 1.5 seconds press jump again **while holding a direction** (forward, back or sideways). The flip gives a burst of speed and a strong hit, so flip into the ball for power shots. Jump again with no direction for a double jump instead.
answers.jump: Press **SPACE** (or **JUMP** on touch, **A** on a controller) to jump. Press it again in the air: with a direction you **flip**, without one you **double jump**. The bot jumps at balls about 3.4 to 7 m high.
answers.boost: Hold **SHIFT** or **L** (or **BOOST** on touch, **B** on a controller) to boost. You have up to 100 boost: small pads give 12, big glowing pads give 100. Pads come back after 4 s (small) or 10 s (big). Top speed is 26 without boost and 44 with it.
answers.air-roll: In the air, use **Q / E** (or **LB / RB** on a controller) to roll the car, and **W / S** to tilt the nose up or down. Use it to land on your wheels and line up aerial hits.
answers.aerial: **Aerials**: jump, tilt the car back (pull back / S), then hold **boost** and keep boosting to fly up to the ball. Steer with tilt and air roll. Start with balls just above the car and go higher as you get the timing.
answers.ball-camera: Press **C** (or **CAM** on touch) to switch the **ball camera** on and off. On keeps the ball in view; off looks where you're driving. Most players keep it on and switch it off to grab boost or line up a shot.
answers.score-tips:
Tips to score more:
- Come at the ball **from behind**, facing the other goal.
- **Flip into the ball** for a power shot.
- Use **ball camera** to keep track of it.
- Grab small boost pads on the way; save the big ones.
- Shoot when the ball is rolling toward you, not away.
answers.defend-tips: Defending tips: get back **between the ball and your goal**, face the ball, and don't chase it into the corners with your teammate. Clear it up the sides rather than across your own goal. Keep some boost for a save.
answers.bot-tips: Beating the bot: wait for it to commit to a hit, then take the ball past it. It jumps at balls about 3.4 to 7 m high, so keep shots low or go very high. Flip shots and shots off the side walls catch it out.
answers.goal-kickoff: After a **goal** there's a slow-motion explosion, then a **kickoff**: everyone goes back to their spawn spot and a 3-2-1 countdown starts. Rush the ball at kickoff, or wait and pick up the ball after the first touch.
answers.match-length: Matches last **2 minutes** by default. If you run matches on your own device (Settings → Custom server → Run on my device), you can pick 2, 3 or 5 minutes in **Customs**.
answers.multiplayer: Tap **MULTIPLAYER** to see the server list. **HOST SERVER** creates a match that everyone who opens the game can see, or **join** one from the list. Up to 6 players; teams are balanced and a bot fills an empty spot. Players on any Rocket Strike site play together.
answers.host: To host: **MULTIPLAYER** → **HOST SERVER**. Your match shows up for everyone. In the lobby press **START MATCH** when ready; otherwise after 30 s with 2+ players a 15 s vote starts. The server runs the match, so you can even switch tabs.
answers.join: To join: **MULTIPLAYER**, then tap a match in the server list. Or open an **invite link** a friend sent you: it joins that match straight away.
answers.invite-link: In the lobby tap **COPY INVITE LINK** (on phones and tablets it opens the share sheet). Send it to your friends: opening the link joins your match directly.
answers.vote-lobby: In the lobby the host can press **START MATCH**. If they don't, after 30 s with 2 or more players a **15 s vote** starts: pick **START NOW** or **WAIT**. Players who don't vote watch from the spectator box.
answers.autopilot: **AUTOPILOT** (host only, in the lobby) decides what happens to players who step away (tab hidden or no updates for 1.5 s): **ON** lets the server drive their car like the bot ("NAME · AUTO"); **OFF** (the default) takes the car off the field until they're back.
answers.two-tabs: Two game tabs on one device: the browser pauses the tab in the background, so that car leaves the field (or autopilot drives it, if the host turned it on). For testing, put both windows side by side, but note that halves performance on iPad.
answers.settings: Open **SETTINGS** from the menu. You'll find: **Join our Discord server**, **Graphics** (quality, resolution, glow, FPS counter), **Custom server** (paste a server link, or run matches on your device) and **Proof** (what the game does and every link it uses).
answers.lag:
If the game lags or stutters:
- Settings → Graphics: **Quality LOW or MEDIUM**, **Resolution 75–90%**, **Glow off**.
- Turn on **Show FPS** to check.
- Close other tabs and apps.
- On iPad, don't play with two windows side by side.
answers.jitter: If other cars or the ball **jump around** online, it's usually a slow or unsteady connection. Check your ping in the players panel, move closer to Wi-Fi, and close downloads or video. Small corrections can happen when two players hit the ball at the same moment.
answers.white-screen: If the screen is white or black or the game won't start: reload the page; check your internet (the first load needs it); try another browser (Safari or Chrome). Very old devices or some in-app viewers can't run the 3D (WebGL).
answers.webgl: "**WebGL is not available**" means this browser or viewer can't run 3D. Open the link directly in **Safari** or **Chrome** (not inside another app's viewer), and update your browser if you can.
answers.cant-host: If **HOST SERVER** is greyed out, the server list isn't connected yet. Wait for "**game server online**", or open the game from one of the live Rocket Strike sites. On a site with no game server only the bot works.
answers.create-failed: "**Could not create a server**" or "**Could not join that server**" means the connection failed or the match closed. Reopen **MULTIPLAYER** and try again in a moment; if it keeps happening, tap the pulse button and I'll check your connection.
answers.match-closed: "**That match isn't open any more**" means the invite link's match has ended. Pick another server from the list, or host your own and send a new invite link.
answers.lost-connection: "**Lost the connection to the game server**" is a network drop. Check your Wi-Fi or data, then rejoin from **MULTIPLAYER**. "Reconnecting to the game server" means it's retrying by itself.
answers.host-left: "**The host left, so the server closed**" only happens with matches run on the host's own device (Custom server → Run on my device): when the host's tab closes or goes to the background, the match stops. Normal matches are run by the online server and keep going.
answers.stuck-goal: Stuck after a goal or out of sync? The game catches up with the server by itself in a moment. If it doesn't, press **LEAVE** and rejoin. After an update, reload all the tabs.
answers.status-line:
The "**Running on …**" line in the menu shows where the game is and its server:
- **game server online**: online play works.
- **reconnecting**: it's retrying by itself.
- **game server not linked yet** / **no game server here, bot only**: only the bot works here; open a live Rocket Strike site or Settings → Custom server → Paste a server link.
answers.custom-server:
Settings → **Custom server**:
- **PASTE A SERVER LINK**: use someone else's Rocket Strike server (an https address).
- **RUN ON MY DEVICE**: matches you host run in your own browser, with **Customs** (match length, players, bot, unlimited boost). Keep your tab open and in front.
- **USE THE ONLINE SERVER** switches back.
answers.customs: **Customs** (for matches you run on your device): match length **2/3/5 min**, players **2/4/6**, bot fills a gap **on/off**, boost **normal/unlimited**. Open them from Settings → Custom server after choosing Run on my device.
answers.graphics: Settings → **Graphics**: Quality **LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH** (pixels, glow, sparks; phones and tablets start on MEDIUM), Resolution **75 / 90 / 100%**, **Glow** on/off and **Show FPS**. They're saved in your browser.
answers.rules: The rules: **be cool**. No swearing, slurs, insults, putting down countries or their people, cheating, spamming or griefing. Admins follow the same rules. Mild words get masked; swearing and slurs are blocked and give **strikes**.
answers.strikes: Strikes add up: a swear word = 1 strike, a slur = 2, putting down a country = a warning. Enough strikes and your chat gets **restricted** (solve a captcha and agree to the rules to unlock it), then you can be **suspended** from online play for a while.
answers.chat-restricted: **Chat restricted**: try to chat and a box opens: solve the captcha and agree to the rules to unlock it. **Suspended**: you can't play online until it ends; the game shows how long is left.
answers.report: To report a player: open the **players panel** in a match, pick the player, tap **REPORT** and choose the reasons. The host's game checks the report (cheating is checked with a movement analysis; a confirmed slur gives two strikes).
answers.chat: Online, press **ENTER** (or the **CHAT** button) to type, and send stickers from the chat bar (one every few seconds). Keep it friendly: rule-breaking words get masked or blocked.
answers.name: Type your name on the main menu (up to 16 characters) and pick your car paint. If it says "**Your name breaks the rules**", choose a different one. Your name is saved in this browser.
answers.saved-data: Your name, paint, settings and strikes are saved **only in this browser**. Private mode or clearing site data resets them, and another device or browser starts fresh.
answers.discord: Join the community on **Discord**: Settings → **Join our Discord server!** (or the Discord button on the main page). Be cool there too: the same rules apply.
answers.log: The **LOG** / **ERROR LOG** button shows recent events: phases, connection, warnings and errors. If something breaks, open it, or tap my pulse button: I'll run a check and read the log to find the cause.
answers.check: Tap the **pulse button** in my text bar (or "Run a check") and I'll test your device, 3D graphics, frame rate, internet, game server, a live connection, multiplayer, the game log, saving and chat, then tell you what's wrong.
answers.helper-modes:
The helper has three modes (top of my chat bubble):
- **LIGHT** (normal): I answer on your device only, with **no cloud calls** unless you tap **☁ Ask the cloud helper**. If I'm not sure I give my best guess or tell you.
- **STABILIZED**: for problems and errors I answer first, then the cloud helper double-checks it with what **2 mini helpers** find in the game's code (they search on your device, so it's one cloud call).
- **ULTRA**: runs a full check plus an asset check (3D engine, fonts, my AI, game files), 2 mini helpers search the code behind anything that fails (on your device), and I change **exactly one setting** to fix it. There's an **Undo** button.
answers.sites: Rocket Strike runs on several sites (Cloudflare, Netlify, Render and Vercel); they're all on the main page under **Where to play**. They share the same game server, so players on any of them see the same matches.
